title: Oven Cooked Vietnamese Beef Stew
description: A bold, bitter-tinged Vietnamese beef stew baked slowly, finished with creamy yogurt and a crunchy dash of fried shallots, perfect for a date night.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat olive oil over medium heat and brown the beef cubes on all sides.
In the same pot, sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato, soy sauce, fish sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, salt, pepper, and return beef to the pot.
Add enough water to cover the ingredients by 1 inch, bring to a simmer, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake uncovered for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Stir in plain yogurt and reheat gently until warmed through, ensuring the yogurt does not curdle.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fried shallots and a drizzle of fresh lime juice if desired.
Let the stew rest for 5 minutes before serving.
